items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Eddie' (Edward Brazio) in the context of a photo with P-Rone, but when asked about Joseph Cherie's relation to 'Eddie Cherie', the interviewee states 'It's a different family altogether.' There is no evidence of a personal or professional relationship between the interviewe

ctx.x: I think we have his picture with P-Rone.
Yeah, he did play with P-Rone. Is that the same man? That's right. Same man, yeah. Now this is Edward Brazio. The bass drum. Eddie, his name is Edward or Eddie? Eddie. Edward. Edward Brazio.
We might mention that he has a little wire beater in his left hand and the drumstick. Uh-huh.
